_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. File names are looked up in ComfyUI's models/ folders (diffusion_models, text_encoders, vae, loras, frame_interpolation).
_image_model_comment: qwen21 = Qwen Image 2.1 (one model for text->image and editing). Set to qwen for the older Qwen-Image-2512 + Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 pair (section 'qwen').

qwen21._fast_comment: Official 8-step Turbo LoRA. For the unofficial 4-step Lightning LoRA set steps 4 and its file name.
qwen21._negative_comment: Only used when cfg > 1 (at cfg 1 ComfyUI skips the negative pass).

inp._comment: Wan 2.2 Fun InP (first/last frame). Used when the project's first/last-frame engine is 'fun_inp'.

camera._comment: Wan 2.2 Fun Camera (camera moves from a start frame).

control._comment: Wan 2.2 Fun Control (motion from a control video: canny, depth, pose...).

vace._comment: Single-model VACE (Wan 2.1 VACE 14B). For a two-stage VACE (e.g. Wan 2.2 Fun VACE) set both high and low.
vace._fill_comment: Value given to the frames/area VACE should generate: 0.5 grey (VACE convention) or 1.0 white (what ComfyUI's own VACE templates use).
vace._color_match_comment: Removes colour drift by matching the output to pixels that must not change (context frames, or a ring around an inpaint mask). 0 = off.

wan.negative: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

finish._comment: Finishing: the selected takes are upscaled to the delivery size before the final render. Projects override these in Settings -> Finishing.
finish._short_side_comment: Output size is the project's aspect ratio at this short side; within 3% of 16:9 it snaps to 1920x1080. Set width and height to force a size.
finish._method_comment: resize = antialiased resize only; model = upscale model (models/upscale_models); refine = Wan low-noise refine pass at refine.short_side, then the upscale model.
finish._interpolate_comment: Frame-rate multiplier for the final render (2 = 16 -> 32 fps), with interpolation_model above.

refine._denoise_comment: 0.2-0.35 adds detail without changing the shot; higher starts to repaint it.
refine._model_comment: Empty = wan.t2v.low (the Wan 2.2 text->video low-noise model) with its fast LoRA.

qwen.negative: 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲
